description: List the org's sobjects (API name and label). No parameters. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing; the sobject list is delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: List every Salesforce object visible to the authenticated user, standard and custom alike, with their API names. The discovery step before querying or describing a particular object, for when you need to know what the org actually contains. Dispatches asynchronously -- a job_id comes back immediately, the full listing follows moments later.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the sobject listing -- it arrives separately, as its own message, when the job completes.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the listing was queued -- do not present job_id/status as the object list. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the sobjects land in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, list the object names and labels plainly; low sensitivity (metadata only, data_sensitivity 0.1).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.auth_failed: the sf CLI has no live session for the registered org. sf.api_error: an unexpected org error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: sf.auth_failed: ask the operator to re-establish the org session with: sf org login web.
